title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 adds faster generation, targeted edits and an in-app sketch tool
friendlyTitle: ChatGPT’s new image model is faster and easier to edit
summary: OpenAI is rolling Images 2.5 out across ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex, claiming up to 50% lower generation latency plus better subject preservation and multi-turn editing. ChatGPT also gains drawing references, templates and image comments, while developers receive Flare and higher-precision Sunburst API models.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says Images 2.5 makes pictures faster, keeps people and objects more consistent and changes only the parts you ask it to change. You can also draw a rough sketch or leave comments on an image.
whyItMatters: Focused edits and stable references can reduce the repeated regeneration that makes AI image workflows slow and inconsistent. Creative teams should test brand and subject fidelity on their own material, retain originals and note that OpenAI applies C2PA metadata and invisible watermarking to generated images.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could save time when making product pictures, flyers or design ideas. Keep your original files and check carefully that important details and brand elements stay correct.
